description.zh:
基线检查项ID。
> 基线检查项ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the check item.

>  You can call the [DescribeCheckWarnings](~~116182~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

description.zh:
检查项告警ID ，有多个检查项告警ID时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 检查项告警ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the alert that is triggered by the check item. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeCheckWarnings](~~116182~~) operation to query the IDs of alerts that are triggered by check items.
The reason for the current operation.

description.zh:
指定要执行忽略或取消忽略操作的风险项ID。
> 风险项ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the risk item that you want to ignore or cancel ignoring.

>  You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~116179~~) operation to query the IDs of risk items.

description.zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询主机基线结果。取值：
- **default**：主机
- **agentless**：agentless
description.en:
The data source. If this parameter is left empty, the server baseline results are queried by default. Valid values:
* **default**: server
* **agentless**
The source IP address of the request.

description.zh:
指定需要执行的操作类型。取值：
- **1**：忽略
- **2**：取消忽略
description.en:
The type of the operation that you want to perform. Valid values:

*   **1**: ignores a risk item
*   **2**: cancels ignoring a risk item

title.zh: 对基线的风险项批量执行忽略或取消忽略

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas ignore-hc-check-warnings --source-ip 192.168.XX.XX --check-warning-ids 98146905,98146907 --check-ids 21313 --risk-id 51 --type 1 --reason ignore --source agentless --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas IgnoreHcCheckWarnings --region cn-hangzhou --RiskId 51 --Type 1 --SourceIp '192.168.XX.XX' --CheckIds 21313 --CheckWarningIds '98146905,98146907' --Reason ignore --Source agentless
